opcodes.name: GoodCRC
opcodes.purpose: Control: acknowledge error-free receipt of the previous message

opcodes.name: GotoMin
opcodes.purpose: Control: Sink must drop to its minimum operating current

opcodes.name: Accept
opcodes.purpose: Control: request or role swap accepted

opcodes.name: Reject
opcodes.purpose: Control: request or role swap rejected

opcodes.name: PS_RDY
opcodes.purpose: Control: power supply ready at the new contract voltage

opcodes.name: Get_Source_Cap
opcodes.purpose: Control: ask the partner to send its Source_Capabilities

opcodes.name: Get_Sink_Cap
opcodes.purpose: Control: ask the partner to send its Sink_Capabilities

opcodes.name: DR_Swap
opcodes.purpose: Control: request a Data Role swap

opcodes.name: PR_Swap
opcodes.purpose: Control: request a Power Role swap

opcodes.name: VCONN_Swap
opcodes.purpose: Control: request a VCONN Source swap

opcodes.name: Wait
opcodes.purpose: Control: defer the request, try again later

opcodes.name: Soft_Reset
opcodes.purpose: Control: reset the protocol layer (MessageID) without removing VBUS

opcodes.name: Source_Capabilities
opcodes.purpose: Data (NumDataObj>=1): Source advertises its list of PDOs. Shares the 4-bit Type 0x01 with the GoodCRC control message; disambiguated by Number of Data Objects in the header.

opcodes.name: Request
opcodes.purpose: Data (NumDataObj>=1): Sink requests one PDO via an RDO. Shares Type 0x02 with the GotoMin control message.

opcodes.name: BIST
opcodes.purpose: Data (NumDataObj>=1): Built-In Self Test. Shares Type 0x03 with the Accept control message.

opcodes.name: Sink_Capabilities
opcodes.purpose: Data (NumDataObj>=1): Sink advertises its list of Sink PDOs. Shares Type 0x04 with the Reject control message.

opcodes.name: Vendor_Defined
opcodes.purpose: Data (NumDataObj>=1): Vendor Defined Message (VDM), e.g. Alternate Mode.

protocol_type: Message-based over CC; 16-bit Message Header selects Control / Data / Extended message types; CRC-32 protected; GoodCRC acknowledged.

channels.name: TX1/RX1 (lane 0)
channels.purpose: High-speed lane 0; 10/20 Gbps; bonded with lane 1.

channels.name: TX2/RX2 (lane 1)
channels.purpose: High-speed lane 1; 10/20 Gbps; bonded with lane 0 for 40 Gbps.

channels.name: CC1/CC2
channels.purpose: USB-C Configuration Channel; USB Power Delivery negotiation + orientation.

channels.name: VBUS
channels.purpose: Bus power per the negotiated PD contract (up to 100 W / 240 W EPR).

packet_id_field.purpose: Each tunneled/transport packet carries a per-hop hop ID; a router maps {input adapter, input hop ID} -> {output adapter, output hop ID} along a configured path.
packet_id_field.structure: Per-router path configuration installed by the Connection Manager; no fixed PID-byte encoding (unlike USB 2.0).

transaction_phases: Link bring-up phase — LT-LFPS training + lane bonding.
Enumeration / configuration phase — Connection Manager reads router config space, builds the spanning tree.
Path/tunnel setup phase — Connection Manager allocates hop IDs and programs each router's path config.
Transport phase — tunneled packets flow end-to-end with transport-layer flow control.

addressing.routing_model: Per-hop hop-ID forwarding through routers (spanning tree).
addressing.router_identification: Topology ID / route string from host router down the tree.
addressing.config_space: Each router exposes a configuration space (router, adapter, path, counters) addressed by the Connection Manager.
addressing.hop_id_role: Identifies a path segment on a given adapter; rewritten at each router hop.

transfer_types.use_case: Tunnel USB 3.2 traffic (up to 20 Gbps) over the fabric.
Tunnel DisplayPort main-link video + AUX; isochronous, TMU-synchronized.
Tunnel PCI Express memory/IO/config transactions (e.g. for eGPU / NVMe).
USB4 host-to-host data path between two host routers.

control_transfer_stages: Config-space read — Connection Manager reads router/adapter capabilities.
Path allocation — Connection Manager assigns input/output hop IDs per hop.
Path config write — each router programmed with its segment of the path.
Tunnel activation — adapters enabled; tunneled traffic begins.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: Transport layer uses credit-based flow control between adjacent routers.
LT-LFPS ordered sets bring up + equalize the link before transport.
Connection Manager-driven path setup must complete before a tunnel carries traffic.
Power Delivery contract on CC pins must be established before high-power VBUS is sourced.

mac_frame_format.sfd: 1 octet 0xD5 (binary 11010101) — Start Frame Delimiter; marks the end of the preamble and the start of the destination-address byte.
mac_frame_format.destination_address: 6 octets (48 bits). Bit 0 of byte 0 = I/G (0=Individual, 1=Group); bit 1 of byte 0 = U/L (0=Universally administered, 1=Locally administered). Reserved values: FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF = Broadcast; 01:80:C2:00:00:0X = Slow Protocols multicast.
mac_frame_format.source_address: 6 octets (48 bits). Must be a unicast address (I/G bit = 0).
mac_frame_format.etheryype_or_length: 2 octets. If value ≥ 0x0600 (1536) it is an EtherType; if ≤ 1500 (0x05DC) it is a payload Length (IEEE 802.3 LLC encapsulation).
mac_frame_format.payload: 46-1500 octets of MAC client data (or 42-1500 in a VLAN-tagged frame). Shorter payloads must be zero-padded by the MAC.
mac_frame_format.pad: 0-46 octets of 0x00 to reach the 64-byte minimum frame length (excluding preamble + SFD).
mac_frame_format.fcs: 4 octets (32 bits). IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 over DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad. Polynomial 0x04C11DB7; reflected representation 0xEDB88320; initial value 0xFFFFFFFF; final XOR 0xFFFFFFFF; LSB-first byte processing.
mac_frame_format.ifg: Inter-Frame Gap: minimum 96 bit times (9.6 µs @10 Mb/s, 0.96 µs @100 Mb/s, 96 ns @1 Gb/s) between back-to-back frames.

mdio_clause22_frame.PRE: 32 contiguous logic-1 bits on MDIO with 32 corresponding MDC cycles. May be suppressed if both ends support preamble suppression (BMSR bit 1.6).
mdio_clause22_frame.ST: <01> — start of frame, ensures transitions from default-1 line state.
mdio_clause22_frame.PHYAD: 5 bits, MSB first. 32 unique addresses; PHYAD 00000 always responded to by a single-PHY connection.
mdio_clause22_frame.REGAD: 5 bits, MSB first. 32 registers; register 0 = BMCR, register 1 = BMSR, register 2/3 = PHY ID, register 4 = ANAR, register 5 = ANLPAR, register 6 = ANER, register 9 = 1000BASE-T Control, register 10 = 1000BASE-T Status, register 15 = Extended Status.
mdio_clause22_frame.TA: 2 bits. Read: bit-0 = high-impedance (both sides), bit-1 = 0 driven by PHY. Write: <10> driven by STA.
mdio_clause22_frame.DATA: 16 bits. First bit on the wire = bit 15 of the register being accessed.

mdio_clause45_frame.OP: <00> = Address (write 16-bit register address into the MMD), <01> = Write data, <11> = Read data, <10> = Post-Increment Read.
mdio_clause45_frame.DEVAD: 5-bit MMD Device Address. Defined MMDs: 1 PMA/PMD, 2 WIS, 3 PCS, 4 PHY XS, 5 DTE XS, 6 TC, 7 Auto-Negotiation, 13/14 EEE, 29 Clause 22 register access, 30/31 Vendor-specific.
mdio_clause45_frame.DATA: Address cycle: 16-bit register address. Data cycle: 16-bit register value (the previously written address selects the register).

transaction_classes_split.interface: Out-of-band Fast Link Pulse on MDI before data signaling begins

frame_format.mac_data_frame: Preamble(7×0x55) + SFD(0xD5) + DA(6 B) + SA(6 B) + Type/Length(2 B) + Payload(46-1500 B) + Pad(0-46 B) + FCS(4 B CRC-32).
frame_format.vlan_tagged_frame: Preamble + SFD + DA(6 B) + SA(6 B) + TPID(0x8100, 2 B) + TCI(2 B = PCP[3] + DEI[1] + VID[12]) + EtherType/Length(2 B) + Payload + FCS — max 1522 B.
frame_format.pause_frame: DA = 01:80:C2:00:00:01, EtherType = 0x8808, MAC Control Opcode = 0x0001, Pause Quanta (16 b), pad to 64 B, FCS.
frame_format.mdio_c22_frame: PRE(32) + ST(01) + OP(10/01) + PHYAD(5) + REGAD(5) + TA(2) + DATA(16) — total 64 MDC cycles (32 PRE + 32 frame).
frame_format.mdio_c45_address: PRE(32) + ST(00) + OP(00) + PRTAD(5) + DEVAD(5) + TA(10) + ADDR(16) — 64 MDC cycles.
frame_format.mdio_c45_data: PRE(32) + ST(00) + OP(01/11/10) + PRTAD(5) + DEVAD(5) + TA + DATA(16) — 64 MDC cycles, must follow an Address cycle on the same DEVAD.
